worldcombat.skill.futuresight.summary: Sends a hunk of its own psychic energy to hover over the target; after a delay it falls for special damage. During the delay the foe can read it and heal or reposition first.
worldcombat.skill.futuresight.use.0: Lock a distant target before the fight starts
worldcombat.skill.futuresight.use.1: Force the foe to spend the delay reacting
worldcombat.skill.futuresight.use.2: Set up an unavoidable strike from a safe distance
worldcombat.skill.futuresight.descriptio: The psychic mote falls after %2$s and deals special damage at %1$s base power.
The mote hovers %1$s blocks above the target, locks targets within %2$s blocks, and covers a %3$s block landing radius.
Prepare %1$s s, recover %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
Delay: the landing is x1.4 later and x1.2 stronger, but the foe has more time to heal, buff defence or pull away.
Quick: the landing is x0.75 sooner and x0.85 weaker, harder to react to.
worldcombat.skill.futuresight.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.futuresight.growth.0: At level %1$s the psychic power rises to %2$s and the landing delay extends to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.futuresight.preference: On (Delay): the landing is x1.4 later and x1.2 stronger, but the foe has more time to heal, buff defence or pull away. Off (Quick): x0.75 sooner and x0.85 weaker, harder to react to.
Future Sight is considered only within this distance; a larger value locks onto more distant foes.
